{
  "score": 7,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 2946,
      "message": "When `--resume --from-stage <s>` is used, `_runner_resume_rehydrate` (line 2946, unconditional in the resume block) and `_runner_from_stage_preflight` (line 3036, conditional on `from_stage`) both call `_artifact_persist_restore` + `_artifact_persist_put_back` to the same `state_dir/artifacts`; the second restore is entirely redundant since `_runner_resume_rehydrate` already placed every artifact before `_runner_from_stage_preflight` runs, doubling the git-archive cost and producing confusing warning messages if the second `put_back` encounters a transient failure after the first succeeded.",
      "quote": "        _runner_resume_rehydrate \"$_runner_issue\" \"$state_dir\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1227,
      "message": "`_cycle_state_jq_write_iter_start` uses `(.cycle_iterations[$id] //= {iter:[]})` as its fallback default — an incomplete schema (missing `status`, `current_iter`, `max_iterations`, `history_file`) compared to `_cycle_state_jq_init`'s full default; if `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` is ever reached when `_cycle_state_init` has not yet written its full object (e.g., if `locked_state_update` creates the key in a concurrent write before init fires), subsequent `get_state_field` calls for `max_iterations` or `status` on that object silently return their zero/empty defaults, corrupting orchestrator state without any error.",
      "quote": "        | (.cycle_iterations[$id] //= {iter:[]})",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 3251,
      "message": "The comment \"stage.start for cycle members is emitted by _cycle_iter_dispatch in cycle-orchestrator.sh (before this hook is called)\" overstates the new behavior: `_cycle_iter_dispatch` only emits `stage.start` for the single interrupted (non-complete) cycle member when `_resume_first_iter=true`; for fresh runs and all subsequent members in the same iteration, no `stage.start` is emitted via that path, so a reader of this comment will incorrectly assume `stage.start` is always present for every cycle member dispatch.",
      "quote": "        # stage.start for cycle members is emitted by _cycle_iter_dispatch in\n        # cycle-orchestrator.sh (before this hook is called), keeping the\n        # emission in one place and making it visible to test harnesses that\n        # mock cycle_dispatch_stage.",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
